notes: Adds API, revocation, and test coverage to complete lifecycle management.

GPTR-F-002-S54.title: Token Revocation Service
GPTR-F-002-S54.description: Implement explicit token revocation capability including status updates, reason logging, and immediate invalidation for revoked tokens. Ensure revocation propagates to validation checks in real time.
GPTR-F-002-S54.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No revocation mechanism exists in current bearer token validation

GPTR-F-002-S55.title: Token Management API Endpoints
GPTR-F-002-S55.description: Expose internal or admin APIs for token issuance, rotation, and revocation, including secure access controls and audit logging hooks aligned with GPTReader usage patterns.
GPTR-F-002-S55.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No lifecycle management endpoints currently exposed

GPTR-F-002-S56.title: Lifecycle Audit Logging Integration
GPTR-F-002-S56.description: Extend audit logging to capture token lifecycle events including issuance, rotation, expiration enforcement, and revocation, ensuring traceability for security and SIT validation.
GPTR-F-002-S56.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/DataPipelines/tests/test_gpt_reader_integration.py; GAP: Lifecycle events not explicitly logged

GPTR-F-002-S57.title: Token Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
GPTR-F-002-S57.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering token expiration, rotation, revocation, and validation paths, including failure scenarios and edge cases aligned with GPTReader SIT expectations.
